messages:
Jordan (PM): Hey design — need a quick turn on a launch tile + 1‑pager variants for next week's webinar. High level: benchmark narrative (latency vs cost), hero tile for socials, 1‑pager for sales, and localized title variants for EN/FR/DE. Due: EOD Thurs.
Amanda P.: Thanks Jordan. Priorities? Webinar hero is top, then 1‑pager, then social microtiles. We also need brand compliance sweep before moving to localization.
Jordan (PM): Correct. Priority order: 1) webinar hero (1200x628, light/dark), 2) sales 1‑pager (A4 & US letter PDFs), 3) three social tiles (1080x1080) with 2 copy variants each.
Kai L.: Quick Q — do we have approved benchmark graphs or do you want us to mock simplified sparkline + cost delta bars?
Jordan (PM): Use simplified sparkline + delta bars. I'll drop the canonical numbers in a sec. Focus on legibility at small sizes and accessible color contrast.
Lina (Design): Ack. I'll start on hero comps. Can you confirm voice: technical but approachable, single sentence tagline + one line subhead with CTA?
Amanda P.: Yes: tagline = "Serve better LLMs — lower cost, lower latency." Subhead: "Live demo + benchmark walkthrough — register" CTA: "Register"
Lina (Design): Awesome. I'll do 3 hero comps (bold, analytical, and friendly). Planning to include overlay card for benchmark snapshot. Will include figma link when ready.
design-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/marketing-launch-tiles — access: anyone with link (view).
Kai L.: For export specs, prefer naming convention: `launch/webinar/<asset>-<variant>-<size>-v1.png`. Example: `launch/webinar/hero-analytical-1200x628-v1.png`
Jordan (PM): Perfect. Also add alt-text drafts for each asset (one sentence each) — required for accessibility and localization team.
Lina (Design): Noted. Also flagging brand constraints: use primary palette only for hero backgrounds, logo lockup must be lower-left, 16px min copy at 1080x1080. Will run contrast check.
Amanda P.: Localization: provide the text layers in a separate Figma page per language (EN/FR/DE). We need space for copy expansion (~20% for DE).
Lina (Design): Will pad for 25% expansion and add a text-only spec sheet for translators.
Jordan (PM): One last ask — create a one‑slide handoff checklist for ops containing: approved files, exports (png/pdf/svg), Figma link, copy table, alt-text, localization pages, and legal mark. Keep it printable.
Lina (Design): Got it — checklist included in the 1‑pager export. ETA: hero comps by tomorrow noon PT, full handoff by EOD Thurs.
Amanda P.: If it's helpful, I'll do a quick copy review after Lina's comps land.
Jordan (PM): Thanks team. Please @channel when the hero is uploaded so growth can start scheduling promo.
Lina (Design): Will do. :sparkles:
